title: UI_Infographic
slide_intent: Make interaction feedback visible at the point of change so a user can connect input and result.
strategic_value: A traveling emphasis within the Schwelle can turn a DB motif into a readable live response.
demonstration: A gray triangular marker tracks above a horizontal red bar group as the thickened cluster changes position.
practical_value: Compare the marker and bar emphasis when deciding how to show live position or feedback.

content_islands.name: Indicator
content_islands.spec: Place the gray triangle above the active portion of the red bar row.

content_islands.name: Response
content_islands.spec: Move the thicker bars with the selected position while other bars remain thin.
